title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 38 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 38)

content.overview: Section 38 permits the arbitral tribunal to fix deposits or supplementary deposits toward the costs referred to in section 31(8). It may require equal shares from the parties and may call for further deposits when necessary.
